logline: On a LaLiga podium Mbappé shoves Yamal off step 1, gets kicked back to 2, Simeone hops up behind him, both stars miss penalties at the cup, Yamal fakes handing it over, slaps Mbappé awake and shows him the table.

beats.idea: podium 1 Barça 36 · 2 Real 33 · 3 Atlético 31; cup on a pole
Mbappé shoves onto step 1 (9 wins in a row); Yamal hangs off the edge (0-2 down)
3-2 comeback kick launches Mbappé back to step 2
Simeone hops three times (3-0 at Getafe), whispers to Mbappé: 2 points behind you
penalties at the cup: Mbappé skies it, Yamal's bonks Simeone
Yamal just climbs the pole and takes the cup
fake handover, snatch, three slaps, head turned up
final LaLiga table 36-33-31; Yamal laughs, Mbappé cries; CTA

twist: after the pushing and the penalties, Yamal simply climbs up and takes the cup — then fakes handing it to Mbappé
callback: the podium labels from the first shot return as the final LaLiga table
hidden_details: the WINS IN A ROW tally fills to 9 bars
Mbappé's skied ball never comes down
Yamal walks off after his miss
meme_frame: Yamal slapping Mbappé on the podium, cup in the other hand
hook_frame0: cover: "FOR YOU"… SLAP on the podium
